scope: Bounded read-only source review plus already-public128 slow-stage rows and compact selected-event projection. No private data, recording payload, complete raw rescan, source edit, test, build or service.

slowStage.timeMeaning: observedAtMs is launcher Node stderr-receive wall time. Instant durations are real span durations; subtracting them does not recover a precise server event timestamp or connection identity.

findings.name: queue timing ends before the current input gate wait
findings.detail: QueuedSocketInput.new sets queued_at=Instant.now separately from the earlier received_at. The queue timer covers construction/send-to-channel-capacity wait/channel residence/consumer scheduling until recv returns. It ends before serial_execution_gate.write.await and before current business execution. It excludes prior parsing, byte permit acquisition and any failed fast-path attempt. The3356ms is therefore not the current command serial_gate.input_wait, Zone work or outgoing-send duration.

findings.name: one queued serial input forces subsequent movement behind it
findings.detail: Constructing a queued input increments pending_count, and its RAII guard remains alive until the consumer branch ends. AttackV2 always queues. The reader fast movement path refuses when pending_serial_actions!=0, so a still-pending attack can force a subsequent Walk into the same serial queue. Removing this test would permit command overtaking and is not a justified fix.

findings.name: the main task cannot take the next input until the current selected branch returns
findings.detail: The main tokio.select is biased with socket input first. When control returns to the select and the channel is ready, timers do not repeatedly win priority. Long pre-dequeue residence is compatible with an already-running branch, channel-send capacity wait, or the task not being polled; the current logs do not choose among these.

findings.name: actual reader fast movement has no hidden post-ACK save or snapshot
findings.detail: The reader awaits spawn_blocking ingress.try_execute, records admission, sends returned packets and returns Ok(true) to its receive loop. It does not call flush_session_updates, save, external-state refresh or world_snapshot afterward. Its read gate does remain held through its send await. Serial movement is a different path.

findings.name: serial postwork can delay live outbound and later queued commands
findings.detail: The input branch holds its write gate through execute, response/snapshot/save/refresh and final V2 receipt. Live outbound needs a read gate. Attack is not a low_latency_action, and V2 receipt is deliberately completed after its normal flush; successful authority execution metrics are recorded before the flush. The nearby151ms flush.save,158ms session_action.flush and161ms outbound-gate wait are compatible with a post-business tail but cannot uniquely be assigned to actor605 without connection/request metadata. They do not explain the preceding3356ms.

findings.name: transport has an independent longer deadline
findings.detail: SocketSender serializes its sink and applies one10s deadline across lock and send/flush. A client900ms attack or2s movement timeout can happen before that server terminal timeout. This does not show a network stall caused the pre-dequeue queue delay.

findings.name: ZoneWork is not all Zone locking or all gateway work
findings.detail: The only gateway record_zone_work call is the RAII timer for shared-owner ticks, started after its Zone lock is acquired. Serial player-command dispatch and world_snapshot have other Zone lock regions not covered by this timer. Immediate/movement admission timers finish on handler completion before transport/flush. Thus a19.765ms ZoneWork maximum cannot rule out every Zone lock wait/hold, snapshot or main-task branch.

unresolved.whatIsEstablished: At least one connection input spent3356ms before current gate/execution. Its approximate time and a later2132ms queue span are compatible with the two actor605 failures; original failures remain failures.
unresolved.criticalSpanCoverage: The public128-row stream contains no serial_gate.input_wait row and no multi-second execute/flush/snapshot span finishing in the critical interval. This limits attribution; it does not prove no uninstrumented wait or scheduling delay.

sourceCandidates.boundary: Same main connection task block_in_place; no enclosing slow-stage label; no serial write gate in this branch. Candidate only, not proved causal.

Identity revocation/database check, resume credential issuance/send and owner lease renewal occur before the tick execution span and before acquiring the tick write gate. Independent narrow lock review requested from partition worker.

sourceCandidates.branch: direct main-task sends and tail synchronization
sourceCandidates.boundary: Chat/AI direct send, selected tail state/identity calls and route refresh synchronization have incomplete substage attribution. Existing full flush spans would capture a long ordinary flush body, but logging itself and unspanned tails remain separate.

minimumNextDiagnostic.purpose: Distinguish main-task branch work from scheduler delay, channel capacity wait, gate wait and socket send; correlate a single actual slow input without changing authoritative behavior.
sourceScope: web.rs connection-local ephemeral diagnostic state and QueuedSocketInput metadata
Versioned strict public slow-stage capture/parser allowlist with bounded fields and limits
fields: Process-local opaque connection ordinal, never a security nonce/account/name/token
Input class and existing validated V2 requestId when present
received-to-queued, channel-send wait, queued-to-dequeued and current serial-gate wait
Main phase and phase entry time sampled when the reader enqueues the same input
Last main-turn completion/select-wait state to distinguish already-busy work from an unpolled ready task
Complete static-label spans around spectator turn, runtime prelude/resume/identity, whole input turn and direct sends
Sink lock wait and socket feed/flush duration separately
minimumNextDiagnostic.bounds: Opt-in only; fixed enum labels and bounded numeric/log records; no gameplay payloads, snapshots or credentials; preserve line/total/backpressure limits and explicit incomplete status.
minimumNextDiagnostic.validation: Deterministic small queue fixture can hold a known main phase and prove the same input reports pre-dequeue wait with that phase; existing fake Sink fixtures can separate lock wait from flush delay. A subsequent fresh diagnostic realm must retain original900ms/2s/18/12/.5 gates and cannot relabel this run.

doNotChange: 900ms attack and2s movement/fanout deadlines or opportunity denominators
V2 receipt placement after existing flush/save
Recording enabled or original gameplay/storage semantics
fixDisposition.conditionalOnly: After an identified span/lock explains the wait, isolate only that non-authoritative work with bounded ownership/order semantics and prove packet/receipt/recording behavior. No spectator, OS or hardware root cause is asserted now.
